data.title: Nectar MCP Brings Consumer and Creator Data to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot
data.description: Palo Alto based company, Nectar, has unveiled Nectar MCP, a platform that links a brand's data to AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot. Nectar MCP aims to bridge the gap between data and AI to enhance marketing efficiency.

data.title: In HelloNation, Insurance Expert Chuck Hall of Millsboro, Delaware Explains What Renters Insurance Covers for Tenants in Delaware
data.description: In Sussex County, many renters are unaware of the importance of having renters insurance until experiencing a loss, as it covers a critical gap not included in a landlord's policy. data.title: HSBC and Ant Digital trial AI-agent payments with tokenized deposits, showcasing real-time settlement and risk checks.
